basis: The independently authored complete Programs are retained with deterministic names only: no context inputs, Relation cte_0/seed_1 then Graph with_graph_2. A Relation selector binding reserves cte_3 before match/rows sga_4; the root traverse is sga_5. A Graph-preserving normalized binding reserves no Relation output, so normalization sga_3 and subsequent keyed match seeds_4 replace the old sga_4/seeds_5. Original operations, schemas, fields, min/max_hops, path_mode, explicit max_output_rows=10 and refusal causes remain fixed. Source spans are counted from authored literal ASCII strings, not product diagnostics.

authored_coordinate_controls.source: WITH n AS (SELECT 1 AS node_key), g AS (GRAPH (NODE TABLES (n AS N KEY (node_key) LABEL Node NO PROPERTIES))), seeds AS (FROM g |> node_rows() |> SELECT id AS element) FROM g |> traverse(start: {from: seeds, id: 'element'}, direction: 'out', min_hops: 0, max_hops: 1, path_mode: 'trail', emit: 'paths', max_output_rows: 10) |> SELECT depth

WITH n AS (SELECT 1 AS node_key), g AS (GRAPH (NODE TABLES (n AS N KEY (node_key) LABEL Node NO PROPERTIES))), seeds AS (FROM g |> node_rows() |> SELECT id AS element) FROM g |> traverse(start: {from: seeds, id: 'element'}, direction: 'out', min_hops: 0, max_hops: 1, path_mode: 'trail', emit: 'paths', max_output_rows: 10) |> SELECT node_id

WITH n AS (SELECT 1 AS node_key), g AS (GRAPH (NODE TABLES (n AS N KEY (node_key) LABEL Node NO PROPERTIES))), seeds AS (FROM g |> match_nodes(definition: 'N', bindings: {identity: 'id'}, where: {literal: true}, fields: ['id']) |> SELECT id AS element) FROM g |> traverse(start: {from: seeds, id: 'element'}, direction: 'out', min_hops: 0, max_hops: 1, path_mode: 'trail', emit: 'paths', max_output_rows: 10) |> SELECT depth
